title: Shortlist: Job-Fit Verdicts With Cited Evidence
description: Paste a job description and get a STRONG FIT / STRETCH / SKIP verdict, the gaps, and a tailored intro draft. Every claimed match quotes a verbatim line from the resume, and a verify_citation function rejects any quote that is not actually there, so a hallucinated match fails instead of shipping. STRETCH roles wait in a human review queue before they move forward. Deployed as a Lemma pod (agent, function, workflow, board app), with the original FastAPI prototype kept for local runs.
